title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 DoS via agent command results was possible (CVE-2026-132245)
description: A denial of service (DoS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions prior to 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The issue arises from processing agent command results, which can be exploited to cause service disruption without requiring authentication.
